subject: Inquiry for LED Panel Light - 3000pcs
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We are interested in your LED Panel Light (Model: PL-6060, 40W, 600x600mm).

Quantity: 3,000 pcs
Target price: USD 12.50/pc FOB Ningbo
Please send your quotation before 2026-09-15.

Best regards,
Michael Chen
Procurement Manager
Global Import Ltd.
note: 标准英文询盘，格式规范——规则层应能抽全，作为基线样本

subject: Request quote - aluminum profile
body:
Hello,

We need aluminum profiles for our window system project.
Item: Aluminum Profile AP-2024, anodized silver
Qty: 5,000 meters
Our budget is EUR 8,90 per meter.
Kindly reply by 15th September 2026.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Klaus Weber
Bauhaus Material GmbH
note: 陷阱1：欧陆数字格式 EUR 8,90（逗号作小数点），与千分位 3,000 易混淆

subject: 铝合金型材询价
body:
你好，

我司需要采购铝合金型材（型号 6063-T5，表面氧化处理）。
数量：500支（每支6米）
目标价格：88元/支
请在2026年9月20日前报价。

杭州华筑装饰工程有限公司
王磊
采购部

expected.customer: 杭州华筑装饰工程有限公司

note: 陷阱2：中文格式（支/元/年月日），规则层需中文单位与日期正则

subject: Office furniture - container order
body:
Hi there,

We'd like to order a full 40HQ container of your office workstation furniture (Model OW-1200).
Please advise the unit price per set and total CIF Felixstowe.
We need the goods delivered by end of October 2026.

Regards,
Sarah Mitchell
UK Interiors Limited
note: 陷阱3：数量隐含在 40HQ 集装箱（无精确数字）、价格待对方报价——测试「诚实缺失」而非瞎猜

subject: Mixed order - tiles and sanitary ware
body:
Dear team,

Please quote for the following:
1) Ceramic floor tile 600x600mm - 2,500 sqm @ USD 6.80/sqm
2) Wall hung toilet CW-880 - 120 sets @ USD 95.00/set
3) Basin mixer tap - 300 pcs, our target USD 22.00/pc

Delivery needed before 2026-10-31.

David Brown
Ausbuild Pty Ltd

expected.product: Ceramic floor tile / Wall hung toilet CW-880 / Basin mixer tap

note: 陷阱4：多产品多数量多价格——规则层易串行错配（数量对不上产品）

subject: RE: Quotation Q-20260815
body:
Hi,

Thanks for your quote. We accept the price of USD 15.20/pc for 1,200 pcs of LED downlight DL-9W.

Please proceed with production. We need shipment by end of next month at the latest.

--- Original message ---
On 2026-08-15 you wrote: "Quantity 800 pcs, price USD 16.00/pc, delivery before 2026-08-30" - please ignore that, the new figures above apply.

James
Nordic Lighting AB
note: 陷阱5（最关键）：正文引用了历史邮件旧数据(800pcs/USD16.00/2026-08-30)。规则层必错，只有 LLM 能识别「以最新数据为准」——这是 LLM 价值的硬证据

subject: Repeat order - same as PO-2026-0432
body:
Hello,

We need to reorder the same items as our previous order PO-2026-0432:
- Acoustic ceiling panel 600x600, 1,800 sqm

Please arrange production, we need it before November 20, 2026.
Price as per previous contract.

Lisa
Canada Decor Inc.
note: 价格「按前合同」未写明——测试缺失识别；含 PO 号干扰项，规则层可能把 PO-2026-0432 当订单号误抽

subject: 办公椅采购
body:
各位好，

需要采购人体工学办公椅（型号 EC-360，网布面料），数量 350 张。
含税单价 ¥580.00/张，需要开13%增值税专用发票。
交货期：2026年11月10日前。

深圳市舒座家具有限公司
陈静

expected.customer: 深圳市舒座家具有限公司

note: 中文 + ¥符号 + 「13%增值税」干扰（规则层可能把 13% 当价格相关数字）

subject: Complaint - defective LED panels, Order PO-2026-0398
body:
Dear Sir,

We received 2,400 pcs of LED panel light (PL-6060) under PO-2026-0398 on 2026-08-20.

Unfortunately, 180 pcs show obvious color temperature deviation (6000K instead of 4000K). Photos are attached.

We request either replacement of the defective units or compensation of USD 3,600.
Please reply before 2026-09-05.

Robert Turner
Operations Manager
US Hotel Group LLC
note: 投诉类陷阱：数量应是**缺陷数量 180 pcs**而非订单总量 2,400 pcs，价格是**索赔额**而非单价——测试 LLM 能否结合语境理解字段含义

subject: Shipping Advice - B/L No. COSU6123456789
body:
Dear Customer,

We are pleased to advise that the following shipment has been dispatched:

Order ref: PO-2026-0512
Goods: Ceramic floor tile 600x600mm
Quantity: 1,680 cartons
Vessel: MV PACIFIC STAR / V.231E
ETD Ningbo: 2026-08-28
ETA Felixstowe: 2026-09-25
B/L No.: COSU6123456789

Please find attached the draft bill of lading for your confirmation.

COSCO Logistics Co., Ltd.
note: 通知类陷阱：含多个日期（ETD 2026-08-28 开船 / ETA 2026-09-25 到港），截止日应取**到港日 ETA**——测试日期仲裁能力

subject: Demande de devis - eclairage industriel
body:

Cordialement,

body:

subject: Request for product catalog and price list
body:
Hello,

We are a distributor based in Nairobi and interested in your LED street lights and LED flood lights. Please send your full product catalog and FOB price list for our review. We expect to place a large order next quarter once we finalize projects.

Best regards,
Bright Future Ltd

expected.product: LED street light / LED flood light

note: 陷阱8：纯目录询价，无数量/价格/截止日——测试「诚实缺失」而非瞎填

subject: Urgent - late shipment PO-2026-0512
body:
Dear Sir,

We ordered 1,680 cartons of ceramic floor tiles under PO-2026-0512, which was supposed to arrive by 2026-09-25 but is still not received as of today (2026-09-30). This delays our renovation project. We request compensation of USD 2,000 for the delay.

Robert Turner
US Hotel Group LLC
note: 投诉类-延迟交货（区别于 E09 缺陷）：数量为订单量 1,680 箱，价格为索赔额，截止日取原定到货日

subject: Payment Advice - T/T for PO-2026-0398
body:
Dear Partner,

We have remitted the balance payment for PO-2026-0398 via T/T.
Amount: USD 28,560.00
Value date: 2026-09-10
Please arrange shipment after fund clearance.

Global Import Ltd.

body:
Hi team,

body:
Buongiorno,

Marco

body:
